title: CS-TFMG Compat
description: A datapack adding compatibility between The Factory Must Grow, Cold Sweat, and optionally, Create: Cold Sweat
body:
# CS-TFMG Compat
This is a datapack that adds Cold Sweat compatability with TFMG's machines and molten fluids. This datapack also comes with Create: Cold Sweat as an optional dependency.
## Features
### Block Temperatures
The following blocks will now have temperatures depending on their contents/inventory:
- Blast Furnace Output
- Blast Furnace Hatch
- Coke Oven
- Casting Basin
### Fluid Temperatures
The following fluids will now have temperatures when placed in the world:
- Molten Steel
- Molten Slag
- Molten Plastic
- Liquid Silicone
### Item Temperatures
The following items will now have temperatures when in hand:
- Lithium Blade (when lit)
### Create: Cold Sweat Compatibility
This datapack will add appropriate tags to TFMG blocks/fluids to give them the same functionality given to create blocks by Create: Cold Sweat.
